title: Jonah Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Jonah 1: the call to Nineveh, the flight to Tarshish, the storm and the lot, and the great fish that swallowed Jonah.

questions.text: Whose son was Jonah, to whom Yahweh's word came?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word came to Jonah the son of Amittai.

questions.text: Which city was Jonah told to go to and preach against?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told him to arise and go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for its wickedness had come up before him.

questions.text: In which city did Jonah find a ship when he fled?
questions.explanation: He went down to Joppa and found a ship going to Tarshish, paid its fare and went down into it.

questions.text: What did Yahweh send out on the sea?
questions.explanation: Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm, so that the ship was likely to break up.

questions.text: What was Jonah doing while the mariners cried out and threw the cargo overboard?
questions.explanation: The mariners threw the cargo into the sea, but Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and was fast asleep.

answers.text: Lying fast asleep in the ship

questions.text: On whom did the lot fall when the men cast lots?
questions.explanation: They cast lots to know who was responsible for the evil that was on them, and the lot fell on Jonah.

questions.text: How did Jonah describe himself to the men?
questions.explanation: He said he was a Hebrew and that he feared Yahweh, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.

answers.text: A prophet sent out from Nineveh
A merchant on his way to Tarshish
A Hebrew who fears Yahweh, God of heaven
A servant of the king of Israel

questions.text: What did Jonah tell the men to do so that the sea would be calm?
questions.explanation: He told them to take him up and throw him into the sea, for he knew the great storm was on them because of him.

questions.text: What did the men do after the sea stopped raging?
questions.explanation: The men feared Yahweh exceedingly, offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and made vows.

answers.text: They set up a stone at Joppa
They offered a sacrifice and made vows

questions.text: How long was Jonah in the belly of the fish?
questions.explanation: Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in its belly three days and three nights.
